name: codex-chatgpt-review-loop
description: User-invoked ChatGPT review loop through an explicitly specified Web LLM Bridge conversation.

interface.shortDescription: Run an explicit-target ChatGPT review loop through Web LLM Bridge.
interface.longDescription: Activates only when the user explicitly requests external ChatGPT review and supplies a ChatGPT conversation URL or Web LLM Bridge session ID. Ordinary coding tasks are unaffected; the static Stop hook is a fail-closed gate and subsequent REVISE rounds are driven directly by the Skill.
defaultPrompt: Use this plugin only when I explicitly request ChatGPT external review and provide a conversation URL or Bridge session ID.
